Original Chronicle artwork generated during this development task.

The Jordan river panorama, John the Baptist NPC and adult Jesus full figure are original image-generation outputs. Their original PNG bytes, alpha, source paths and hashes are retained in manifest.json. Runtime UV regions and continuous weighted meshes assemble/animate the character; no raster retouching is applied.

The boy uses the preserved GospelRadiance original atlas and a revised continuous limb rig. A requested separate-piece sheet was rejected by the image tool. A fully clothed intact child request was also rejected; no further child-generation attempt was made. Do not describe the revised boy as newly generated child artwork.

The biblical setting is an artistic learning-game composition, not a measured archaeological reconstruction or a verified likeness. Existing Lost Crypt/Unity Companion assets retain their original notices. No Ori source or extracted Ori artwork is included in these new assets.
